protocol.action_label: Observed positive or negative terminal reward from a fresh reset of the same measured prestate
protocol.selection: Retain only groups with both terminal reward classes
protocol.model_input: Visible goal, candidate text/type/role/geometry/CSS colors; no reward labels or screenshots in prompts
protocol.metric: Groups where the selected first action has observed positive terminal reward

runs.name: shape_holdout_exploratory
runs.finding: The larger frozen model exceeds literal matching on an inspected synthetic shape holdout. The trained 0.6B head overfits validation and underperforms its frozen base.

runs.name: color_holdout_exploratory
runs.finding: The 2B model matches a literal color-name baseline, so 12/12 is not evidence of learned visual world dynamics or Jev-like reasoning. The trained 0.6B head improves over its frozen base but remains below literal matching.

limitations: Synthetic one-step browser controls, not multi-step execution, real desktop transfer, physical-world prediction, safety, or Jev parity.
Task families and representations were explored before these small holdouts; neither run is a preregistered independent benchmark.
The color goal and control metadata expose exact matching names, as demonstrated by the 12/12 no-model baseline.
The selected contrastive groups do not estimate unbiased success on all generated MiniWoB episodes.
No Jev responses were used as training labels; the reward head is research-only and is not integrated into Heliox's action authority.
